tldr:
For the latent marginal median treatment effect \(\theta(P)=q_1(P)-q_0(P)\) on the entire public-radius class \(\mathcal M_\rho\), the sharp rates are
\[
 r(n,m,\rho)=\min\{1,n^{-1/2}+\rho^{3/8}n^{-5/16}+\rho m^{-5/14}\},
 \qquad
 r_{\mathrm{known}}(n,\rho)=\min\{1,n^{-1/2}+\rho^{3/8}n^{-5/16}\}.
\]
Absolute minimax risk and minimax expected connected confidence length under exact finite-sample coverage at least \(0.90\) are each equivalent to their respective rates, uniformly for \(n\ge2\), \(m\ge1\) and \(0\le\rho\le1\), with no logarithmic loss. Along joint resource sequences with \(n\to\infty\), discrepancy-only calibration retains known-error order if and only if \((\rho\sqrt n)^{7/4}/m\) stays bounded; either experiment retains the radius-zero root-\(n\) order if and only if \(\rho\sqrt n\) stays bounded. The clipped common-inverse estimator and legal annular alternatives close the full-class criterion. The named consumer is a prospective latent-earnings extension of the qte randomized-assignment workflow; the displayed universal constants establish existence and order, not practical interval widths.
gap: Square-root discrepancy recovery, single-law quantile estimation and generic quantile bands are established. Their inspected theorems do not give the full-class latent median-contrast precision frontier jointly in \(n,m,\rho\), including bounded calibration and public shrinking shape radii.
